Founded in 2026, VILLALOBOS SB TRADING LLC operates as a localization, dubbing, and digital syndication agency for vertical micro-dramas. Our services cover overseas content adaptation, AI-assisted multilingual dubbing, and multi-channel distribution.

We adapt dialogue, subtitles, voice tracks, and delivery formats for the intended audience. Distribution scope is agreed project by project, with title-specific rights, territories, languages, and platforms confirmed before release.

From concept to connection

One vision. End-to-end execution.

Localization, AI-assisted dubbing, and distribution — connected by a practical, project-specific delivery workflow.

01 / LOCALIZE

Localization & Adaptation

Overseas micro-drama adaptation for mobile audiences. Dialogue, on-screen text, subtitles, and visual edits are tailored to the intended market and the approved project brief.

Source review → Adaptation → Delivery
02 / DUB

Localization & Dubbing

AI-assisted multilingual translation and dubbing, paired with editorial review, subtitle timing, and voice-track alignment. English, Spanish, and Portuguese workflows are scoped to each project.

Local language. Original emotion.
03 / DISTRIBUTE

Multi-Platform Syndication

Delivery preparation for short-form video ecosystems and mini-apps, including channels such as TikTok. Publishing scope follows the agreed rights, territories, language versions, and platform requirements.
